Color Palette Generator - Create Beautiful Color Schemes

name: Muzli Colors
summary: Color palette generator with presets and popular palettes, plus live previews of any palette on UI mockups.
description: Muzli's color tool: start from a base color or a recommended preset, generate a scheme, and hover suggested combinations to preview them live on a landing page, dashboard, icon, logo, pricing page, illustration or mobile app mockup. Popular palettes are seeded by hex color, and a color names index lists hex codes under named colors. A Muzli browser extension is promoted alongside the tool.
contains: palette generator starting from an initial color or a preset
live previews on landing page, dashboard, icon, logo, pricing page, illustration and mobile app mockups
popular color palettes browsable by hex color
color names index with hex codes
